Here’s what’s new with Genie 4:
🔵 Photorealism: Built on Gemini Omni for lifelike detail across spaces and subjects
🔵 Advanced physics: Aerodynamics, collisions, and people who move naturally
🔵 Real-time controls: Prompt to change the scene, add elements, or interact with https://t.co/3l2RvELUK0

This is Genie 4, our most realistic and interactive world model yet. 🌐

Explore dynamic environments in real time to see how the scene responds, sounds, and how the people in it move, react, and speak. https://t.co/6mmSUm9BBO

The demo above shows how all these capabilities come together in real time. Prompt “traffic light green,” and Gemini reasons through what happens next as the signal changes: the engine revs, and the motorcycle accelerates down the coast.
